plugins.name: odeuropa-eokg
plugins.description: Search the European Olfactory Knowledge Graph (Odeuropa): about 2.4 million smell references from European texts and artworks, mostly 1600–1920, with a research guidance skill.

interface.shortDescription: Search historical smell references in European texts and artworks

plugins.name: skkg
plugins.description: Search the collection of the Stiftung für Kunst, Kultur und Geschichte (SKKG, Winterthur): about 64,000 objects with German metadata, provenance, acquisitions, literature, exhibitions and images.

interface.shortDescription: Search the SKKG collection in Winterthur

plugins.name: rijksmuseum-iconclass
plugins.description: Search and browse the Iconclass art-subject classification: about 1.3 million notations in 13 languages, with keyword and semantic search and Rijksmuseum artwork counts, plus a research guidance skill.

interface.shortDescription: Find Iconclass codes for art subjects, with Rijksmuseum artwork counts

plugins.name: rijksmuseum
plugins.description: Search the Rijksmuseum's collection of Dutch art, crafts and history by metadata, iconography and provenance, by meaning, by describing what an image shows, or by similarity to another work, and view high-resolution images. Includes a research guidance skill.

interface.shortDescription: Search the Rijksmuseum collection: art, provenance and images
